evidence.activity: Title sponsorship of the BNI Java Jazz Festival, a large international music festival
evidence.quote: Sebagai bagian dukungan BNI dalam event International BNI Java Jazz Festival 2025, BNI menyiapkan deretan promo menarik selama festival musik terbesar di Asia Tenggara tersebut berlangsung.
evidence.quote_en: As part of BNI's support for the International BNI Java Jazz Festival 2025, BNI prepared a series of attractive promotions during the largest music festival in Southeast Asia.
evidence.section: Annual report > Peristiwa Penting 2025 > 30 Mei - 1 Juni BNI Java Jazz Festival 2025

creativity.criterion: level 2: a single named arts (music festival) sponsorship, limited reach disclosed

evidence.activity: BNI University training and development programs for nearly all employees
evidence.quote: Sepanjang tahun 2025, BNI telah menyelenggarakan berbagai program pendidikan dan pelatihan yang diikuti oleh 26.937 pegawai atau setara dengan 99,96% dari total pegawai BNI.
evidence.quote_en: Throughout 2025, BNI held various education and training programs attended by 26,937 employees, or 99.96% of all BNI employees.
evidence.section: Annual report > Profil Perusahaan > Pengembangan Kompetensi Pegawai

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Financial education and consumer protection session for new University of Indonesia students
evidence.quote: Sosialisasi Edukasi Pelindungan Konsumen dilakukan pada acara PKKMB UI 2025.

evidence.section: Annual report > Peristiwa Penting 2025 > 8 Agustus Edukasi dan Pelindungan Konsumen kepada mahasiswa baru Universitas Indonesia

community.criterion: level 2: specific external financial education activity, limited reach

evidence.activity: Agen46 community event with village cooperatives that included education on inclusive banking services
evidence.quote: Kegiatan tersebut dikombinasikan dengan lomba 17 Agustusan yang diikuti warga dari berbagai usia, sekaligus menjadi ajang edukasi layanan perbankan inklusif seperti Laku Pandai, layanan keuangan digital, dan e-payment tanpa harus ke kantor cabang.
evidence.quote_en: The activity was combined with Independence Day competitions joined by residents of all ages, and also served as education on inclusive banking services such as Laku Pandai, digital financial services and e-payment without visiting a branch.
evidence.section: Annual report > Peristiwa Penting 2025 > 17 Agustus Event Lokal Merdeka Bertransaksi di BNI Agen46

community.criterion: level 2: specific community financial literacy event with cooperatives, limited reach

evidence.activity: BNI Remittance financial literacy, capacity building and community visits for Indonesian migrant workers in Hong Kong
evidence.quote: BNI Remittance juga aktif terlibat dalam beberapa kegiatan dengan PMI seperti capacity building , literasi keuangan, kunjungan ke komunitas-komunitas PMI di Hong Kong, dan lain sebagainya.
evidence.quote_en: BNI Remittance is also actively involved in activities with Indonesian migrant workers (PMI), such as capacity building, financial literacy and visits to PMI communities in Hong Kong.
evidence.section: Annual report > Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen > Perusahaan Anak > BNI Remittance

community.criterion: level 2: external financial literacy program, no reach figures

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: services and literacy for an underserved migrant-worker community, no figures

evidence.activity: BNI Xpora portal offering video-based business learning and training modules to MSMEs
evidence.quote: Portal ini juga memperkaya kapabilitas UMKM melalui akses wawasan dan pembelajaran bisnis berbasis video dan modul pelatihan, serta menghadirkan inspirasi pengembangan usaha.
evidence.quote_en: The portal also strengthens MSME capabilities through access to insights and business learning via videos and training modules, and offers inspiration for business development.
evidence.section: Annual report > Fungsi Penunjang Bisnis > BNI Xpora

community.criterion: level 2: external skills program for small business owners, no participant figures for the learning component

evidence.activity: BNI Agen46 branchless banking agent network reaching underdeveloped, frontier and outermost (3T) regions
evidence.quote: Hingga akhir tahun 2025, BNI memiliki 1.776 outlet, 13.391 ATM/CRM, dan 217 .013 agen Branchless Banking (BNI Agen46) yang tersebar hingga ke wilayah 3T (Tertinggal, Terdepan, dan Terluar).
evidence.quote_en: By the end of 2025, BNI had 1,776 outlets, 13,391 ATMs/CRMs and 217,013 branchless banking agents (BNI Agen46) spread as far as the 3T regions (underdeveloped, frontier and outermost).
evidence.section: Annual report > Keunggulan Kompetitif BNI > 04 Jaringan Kantor Domestik yang Inklusif

cross_cultural.criterion: level 3: named access program for underserved remote communities with substantial measured reach

evidence.activity: Wondr Everywhere Beijing event bringing together the Indonesian diaspora and local Chinese community
evidence.quote: Kehadiran lintas komunitas ini memperkuat hubungan budaya dan bisnis antara Indonesia dan China dalam suasana kebersamaan yang hangat.
evidence.quote_en: The cross-community attendance strengthened cultural and business ties between Indonesia and China in a warm spirit of togetherness.
evidence.section: Annual report > Peristiwa Penting 2025 > 17 Agustus Wondr Everywhere - Beijing Edition

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: single cross-community event, limited reach

evidence.activity: BNI Xpora program helping export-oriented MSMEs reach global markets through financing, business matching, legal and SME tools
evidence.quote: Hingga 31 Desember 2025, program BNI Xpora telah mendorong 12.094 pelaku UMKM untuk meraih pasar global.
evidence.quote_en: As of 31 December 2025, the BNI Xpora program had helped 12,094 MSMEs reach global markets.
evidence.section: Annual report > Fungsi Penunjang Bisnis > BNI Xpora

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 3: named enabling program with number of businesses helped

evidence.activity: BNIdirect bisnis digital business platform built for MSMEs
evidence.quote: Salah satu inovasi utama yang diluncurkan pada Agustus 2025 adalah BNIdirect bisnis, sebuah platform digital yang dirancang khusus untuk merangkul dan mempermudah bisnis berskala UMKM agar dapat menikmati layanan perbankan digital yang setara dengan perusahaan korporasi.
evidence.quote_en: One of the main innovations launched in August 2025 is BNIdirect bisnis, a digital platform designed specifically to embrace and simplify MSME-scale businesses so they can enjoy digital banking services on par with corporations.
evidence.section: Annual report > Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen > Corporate Banking > Keunggulan Kompetitif dan Inovasi

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 2: business software built for small businesses, no user figures

evidence.activity: hibank's hi by hibank app for MSME digitalization, with business consulting, education and financing
evidence.quote: Pada tahun 2025, hibank secara resmi meluncurkan aplikasi mobile banking  hi by hibank sebagai solusi digital terintegrasi yang dirancang khusus untuk mendukung digitalisasi serta pengembangan UMKM di Indonesia.
evidence.quote_en: In 2025, hibank officially launched the hi by hibank mobile banking app as an integrated digital solution designed specifically to support the digitalization and development of MSMEs in Indonesia.
evidence.section: Annual report > Profil Perusahaan > Perusahaan Anak > PT Bank Hibank Indonesia

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 2: business tool built for small businesses, no user figures

evidence.activity: BNI Ventures' BNV Arcade accelerator and incubation program for startups
evidence.quote: Dalam rangkaian aktivitas tersebut, BNI Ventures menyelenggarakan program akselerasi dan inkubasi dengan menggandeng mitra strategis, serta membuka pintu match-making antara perusahaan rintisan dengan unit bisnis terkait di BNI Group.
evidence.quote_en: As part of these activities, BNI Ventures ran acceleration and incubation programs with strategic partners and opened match-making between startups and related business units in BNI Group.
evidence.section: Annual report > Analisis dan Pembahasan Manajemen > Perusahaan Anak > BNI Ventures

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 2: accelerator program, no participant figures

creativity.reason: Level 2: one specific current arts sponsorship (BNI Java Jazz Festival) with no reach indicators.

community.reason: Level 2: large employee development plus several small external financial-literacy activities, none with substantial measured reach.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 3: the named Agen46 access network for underserved 3T regions has substantial measured reach (217,013 agents, 121.8 million transactions).

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 3: the named BNI Xpora enabling program reports 12,094 MSMEs helped, supported by SME-specific tools and an accelerator.

ai.notes: The Java Jazz sponsorship is framed largely as customer acquisition. It still counts as a single arts sponsorship at level 2. Distribution of government scholarships and social aid (PIP, Beasiswa Unggulan, teacher allowances) uses state funds disbursed by BNI as an agent bank, so it is not scored as BNI's own community investment. KUR and other ordinary SME lending (SME segment Rp78.7 trillion) count as 'serving' only. The TJSL/CSR section in the excerpt contains only general language. CSR program figures may exist elsewhere in the report but were not in the provided text. The Wondr ITB Ultra Marathon inclusive run with disabled participants was organized by ITB, with BNI as sponsor, and was not scored. The Agen46 3T reach is scored as customer access for underserved remote communities. Workforce gender data is disclosure only. The Indonesian migrant-worker literacy in Hong Kong is supported by an IFEC Hong Kong award but has no reach figures. Indicative final score: 14 + 12 + 12 + 9 = 47/100.
